summary: Iteration 29 — Verified mobile+OTP alternate login (DEV mode) end-to-end plus regression of email/password login and persistence of new phone fields on signup/member/company forms. BACKEND: 15/15 pytest passed in 4.18s (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration29.py). BACKEND coverage — TestEmailPasswordRegression (3): owner login, bad password → 401, /auth/me with token; TestOtpFlow (8): request returns {dev_mode:true, dev_otp:'######'} for registered phone; verify success returns token+user (name='Amit Verma', role='production')+tenant and token works against /auth/me; re-using the same OTP fails with 400 (record deleted after use); verify without prior request → 400 'Request an OTP first'; wrong 6-digit code → 401 'Incorrect OTP'; unregistered mobile → 404 'No account is registered...'; invalid short phone → 400; _norm_phone accepts '+91 98200 10001' → matches owner; TestRegisterWithPhone (1): register w/ phone stores it, new user can OTP-login; TestMemberPhone (1): owner POST /users w/ phone → member OTP-logs-in; PATCH /users/:id phone → new phone OTP-logs-in, old phone → 404; TestTenantPhone (2): PATCH /tenant phone works for owner (restored to original), production role → 403. FRONTEND (Playwright, 8 flows): (1) email/password login for owner@sharma.com/demo1234 works — token stored, redirects off /login; (2) OTP tab: fill 9820010003 → auto-fills 6-digit dev_otp in otp-code-input, Verify & sign in → logged in as Amit Verma at Sharma Textiles Pvt Ltd; (3) 9999999998 (unregistered) → auth-error text 'No account is registered with this mobile number' (from 404), otp-code-input NOT shown; (4) 9820010002 + wrong code '000001' → auth-error 'Incorrect OTP' (from 401), stays on /login, no redirect; (5) register-phone-input present on onboarding-step-1 with placeholder 'Mobile number (for OTP login)'; (6) company-profile-button opens company-dialog with company-field-phone visible; save via company-save-button persisted (verified on reopen — value '+91 90000 90000' persisted across runs, backend PATCH /tenant confirmed by pytest); (7) People > people-tab-employees → 27 edit-access buttons + 1 add-user-button; MemberDialog opens with member-phone-input (placeholder 'Mobile number (for OTP login)'); (8) OTP form shows otp-change-number and otp-resend after code sent; Change resets otp-phone-input to enabled. Every acceptance criterion from the review request verified. Only console noise: repeated warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — accessibility hint, non-blocking.

issues: shadcn DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — a11y warning only, no functional impact

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:842-921 OTP module is clean and self-contained: SHA-256 hash salted with phone+static salt in db.otp_codes; 300s TTL; 5-attempt cap; 30s resend cooldown; record deleted on successful verify (prevents re-use — covered by test_verify_reuse_same_code_fails). DEV mode returns dev_otp only when Twilio env vars are absent — remove the `resp['dev_otp'] = code` line once Twilio creds land (already flagged with a 'DEV ONLY — remove once Twilio is live' comment).

server.py:3151 `_norm_phone` = last-10-digits of digits-only string — same helper used for user matching in /auth/otp/request and /auth/otp/verify AND for WhatsApp resolution. Consistent, no drift. Correctly handles '+91 98200 10001' → '9820010001'.

server.py:869 candidates scan (`db.users.find({'phone': {'$exists': True, '$ne': ''}}).to_list(2000)`) is a full-collection linear scan on each OTP request. FINE at demo scale; at 10k+ users this becomes a hot path. Suggestion: store a normalized `phone_last10` field on users and add a MongoDB index on it — then look up by exact match instead of scanning + client-side filter. Non-blocking.
server.py:913 verify does the same linear scan after code passes — same optimisation opportunity as request.

server.py:889 `_send_otp_sms` swallows Twilio errors and returns False, but the /request handler still responds 200. If Twilio fails silently after real go-live, users will never see an OTP but the API will look healthy. Consider returning 502/503 (or a 'send failed' body flag) when Twilio is expected to send and _send_otp_sms returns False.

server.py:836-839 constants (TTL, attempts, cooldown, TWILIO_ENABLED) are module-globals computed at import. Fine for a single-process app; if you ever move to hot-reloading Twilio creds you'd need re-init. Non-blocking.

AuthContext.js:45-49 `loginWithOtp` correctly reuses the same `persist()` path as email/password login — so the JWT ends up in localStorage under the same key `dos_token` and /auth/me populates the user + tenant identically. No branching / no regressions to existing auth-gated flows.

Login.js:83-99 requestOtp / submitOtp — logic is tight: on success in dev mode, `toast.info(Dev OTP: ...)` + `setOtpCode(data.dev_otp)` auto-fills the input; on error, `formatApiError(err.response?.data?.detail)` renders inline in `data-testid=auth-error`. Only nit: when the user presses 'Send OTP' twice within 30s the backend returns 429 — this is surfaced as the same auth-error text; UX would be nicer with a countdown on the Resend button, but functional today.
Login.js:262 the 'Change' button uses `data-testid=otp-change-number` and correctly resets `otpSent=false`, `otpCode=''`, `error=''`. Good.
Team.js:47,51 MemberDialog sends `phone` on both PATCH (edit) and POST (create). Matches server UserCreateInput/UserUpdateInput which both accept optional phone. Verified round-trip via pytest.

CompanyDialog.js:10-19 FIELDS array now includes `{ key: 'phone', label: 'Company mobile' }`; the field is rendered inside the same grid and gated by `canManage` (disabled for non-owners) — matches server TenantUpdateInput. Verified via pytest that non-owner gets 403.
Nice-to-have (carry-forward from iter25/27): server.py is now ~3498 lines. Splitting into routers (auth.py, otp.py, tenants.py, users.py) would help further; not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter29 adds mobile+OTP alternate login (DEV mode). Rerun backend: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration29.py -o addopts= -v` — expect 15 pass in ~4s. Key facts: (1) OTP endpoints have a 30s resend cooldown per phone — for pytest we bypass via `_reset_otp(phone)` which deletes db.otp_codes rows directly using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env; do the same if you need to run OTP tests back-to-back. (2) `_norm_phone` = digits-only, last-10 — so '+91 98200 10003' == '9820010003' == '00919820010003'. (3) DEV mode is engaged when Twilio env vars (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN/TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER) are absent — in DEV, POST /api/auth/otp/request returns {sent:false, dev_mode:true, dev_otp:'######'} and the frontend auto-fills otp-code-input from data.dev_otp AND surfaces toast.info(`Dev OTP: ${code}`). (4) Successful /verify deletes the otp_codes row so re-using the same OTP → 400. (5) Frontend data-testids: login-tab-password / login-tab-otp / otp-form / otp-phone-input / otp-code-input / otp-submit-button / otp-resend / otp-change-number / register-phone-input (step 1) / member-phone-input (Team.js MemberDialog) / company-field-phone (CompanyDialog). (6) Existing tenant.phone on the demo has been set to '+91 90000 90000' by these tests — the pytest owner-tenant-phone test restores original, so if this value persists it's the actual seeded/prior value; no action needed. (7) Twilio-live migration: remove the `resp['dev_otp'] = code` line in server.py:892 and any `if (data.dev_otp)` autofill/toast in Login.js:88-90.
rca of the issue: N/A — new-feature verification pass. Every criterion in the review request (JWT parity between email/password + OTP, dev-mode auto-fill, error messages, phone persistence on signup/member/company) is functionally correct and covered by pytest + Playwright. No bugs found.
